225-765-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-765-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

891-6495-8207.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
891-6495-8207.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-308-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Spawning Pit abilities
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4321-5777-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4321-5777-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
4321-5777-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-1445-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5477-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5477-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

789-2511-2738-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4986-6797-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
4986-6797-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-2646.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-2646.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

969-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
969-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4477-7182.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 4 life this turn.
3497-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

49-2034-4871-6747-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

1978-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct or activate Trazyn using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

539-5256-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-2854-4211-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1395-2854-4211-4574.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Showdown of the Skalds trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

593-1640-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Mogg Maniac instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

3094-6286.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
3094-6286.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Unstoppable Plan triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of other nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Unstoppable Plan's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Unstoppable Plan's trigger, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2751-6286.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
2751-6286.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Unstoppable Plan triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of other nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Unstoppable Plan's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Unstoppable Plan's trigger, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2416-3525-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
2416-3525-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
2416-3525-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

2034-2048-6351-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2048-6351-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

1617-3680-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Stunt Double on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-3680-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Stunt Double to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

2558-5330-5687-5692.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1575-3000-4826-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Squirrel.
1575-3000-4826-5776.description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing a Squirrel, targeting any creature.
When the Squirrel dies as a Food due to Ygra, Ygra and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token, which enter the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Chatterfang abilities, giving the targeted creatures +1/-1 until end of turn for each ability.

4050-4484-4871-5465.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-4871-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

1348-1460-4657.notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.You control at least three artifacts.
1348-1460-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Vault of Catlacan's second ability by tapping it, adding {U} for each artifact you control.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Vault of Catlacan.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1737-3129-4715.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Prized Statue.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures and/or Prized Statue tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1096-2376-4050.notablePrerequisites: Woodfall Primus does not have a -1/-1 counters on it.
1096-2376-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Woodfall Primus, adding one mana of any color.
Woodfall Primus's persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with no counters on it due to Woodfall Primus's riot ability.
Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, destroying target noncreature permanent.
Repeat.

1430-3913.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, without using {R}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Crypt Champion.
Mirror Image enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Mirror Image trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Resolve the first Mirror Image trigger, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Crypt Champion.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-1671-3678.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-3678.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1992-2744-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2744-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding one mana of any color.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
